content:
Context: 5. Advance Increments

80 w.p.m. may be granted one advance increment on qualifying speed test w.p.m. and one more advance increment on qualifying speed test in shorthand at 120 w.p.m. while in service. However, if a Stenographer who is recruited on the basis of speed test in the shorthand at 80 w.p.m. directly qualifies the speed test in shorthand at 120 w.p.m.  
in shorthand at 100 while in service, he/she may be granted two advance increments.
